The families have also found something unclassified in the chamber's approach area (not yet disclosed to the Guild or the Concordat) that changed their posture without requiring the chamber itself to be opened.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Weighing Communities' (Google Drive fileId 1F301LbnBlDOajOvmOuHbT_zheWrwlbKi), Batch 12, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Measurist Guild is a two-hundred-year-old, publicly legitimate professional association of surveyors and engineers, licensed across all five Shattered Kingdoms nations, whose institutional strategy from founding was to make itself operationally indispensable (every significant building and land-boundary dispute passes through Guild certification) specifically so no government could afford to shut it down.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Weighing Communities' (Google Drive fileId 1F301LbnBlDOajOvmOuHbT_zheWrwlbKi), Batch 12, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Measurist Guild's private layer is the True Map: a distributed system of coded annotations layered inside ordinary survey records, using a notation system the Guild adapted from recovered Old Dominion administrative cipher conventions. Two hundred years of survey work across every nation has made it the single most comprehensive intelligence document on Old Dominion infrastructure in existence, including knowledge of the Ledger Families' dig site, the Weighing Communities' Anchor Stones, and SBD buildings on Old Dominion foundations. Only senior Annotators and the Master Surveyor can access the complete corpus.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Weighing Communities' (Google Drive fileId 1F301LbnBlDOajOvmOuHbT_zheWrwlbKi), Batch 12, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: Measurist Guild membership uses professional competence itself as the induction filter: a candidate is given a normal-looking survey assignment of a site the Guild already knows is Old Dominion significant, and is approached for private-layer induction only if their report unprompted flags the specific real anomaly the Guild expects. This makes the private layer's membership genuinely skilled rather than merely devoted.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Weighing Communities' (Google Drive fileId 1F301LbnBlDOajOvmOuHbT_zheWrwlbKi), Batch 12, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Measurist Guild's Accounting is a monthly administrative review of True Map updates, with permanent named credit to the discovering Annotator. Its business model is a location service, not object acquisition: it sells knowledge of where relics are, keeps its public reputation clean of any specific object's fate, and enforces an unofficial but broadly respected claim on relics found at Guild-annotated sites by restricting True Map access to organizations that don't honor it.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Weighing Communities' (Google Drive fileId 1F301LbnBlDOajOvmOuHbT_zheWrwlbKi), Batch 12, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Measurist Guild's primary two-century relic interest is locational: triangulating the physical site of T.D.K.'s central administrative infrastructure, which their analysis places in a specific mountain range in the Hollow Shogunate's interior. They cannot survey it without Shogunate permission, which has never been granted, and have spent two centuries patiently surveying every accessible perimeter angle instead.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Weighing Communities' (Google Drive fileId 1F301LbnBlDOajOvmOuHbT_zheWrwlbKi), Batch 12, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: Three weeks before the double regicide, a Measurist Guild survey team assessed the Fulfillment Ceremony grounds at Karkosa on a legitimate contract and found, in the sub-basement, structural evidence of a Crown-Scar documentation chamber cross-referenced in the same annotation to an Oracle node inside an SBD regional administrative building nearby, meaning the ceremony was held directly above live T.D.K. infrastructure. The surveyor who found and annotated this was killed by the Concordat of the Long Account three days after the double regicide, for having told a Concordat contact about the finding before filing it. The annotation itself survived, unread, in the Guild's archive, waiting for Fermand.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Weighing Communities' (Google Drive fileId 1F301LbnBlDOajOvmOuHbT_zheWrwlbKi), Batch 12, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: Post-containment, the Measurist Guild's Master Surveyor has decided to offer the True Map to whoever contained T.D.K. as an institutional-survival bargaining instrument, judging the Guild's protective network of relationships (the Concordat, the Patient Caucus) too internally fractured to protect it otherwise. This has fractured the Guild along a leadership-survival line versus a 'the Map is owed to the King alone' practitioner line; three senior Annotators are dead, and the Master Surveyor privately suspects one specific Annotator but has not confronted them. The True Map's disposition remains unresolved; a second, undisclosed position within the practitioner faction holds that the Map should be destroyed rather than handed over. Cross-reference note: introduces the Domus Inviolate Reader's murder (the calibration rod taken, the Crown-Scar rubbing confiscated) from the Concordat's side; new material, not a contradiction of anything locked, to be formally cross-referenced when the Domus Inviolate batch runs.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Weighing Communities' (Google Drive fileId 1F301LbnBlDOajOvmOuHbT_zheWrwlbKi), Batch 12, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Weregildd is a standalone criminal syndicate, not part of T.D.K.'s cult network, running the shadow economy beneath the Maw System. Its true name is known only to insiders. Four separate circles, each seeing only its own piece of the operation, know it by a different alias: financial and debt circles call it the Writedown Compact, trafficking and handler circles call it the Undercroft Exchange, medical and body-harvest circles call it the Salvage Concordance, and arena and betting circles call it the Offcut Exchange. Its concealed seat of operations is Blakhanders' Cove.
rules.source: Original invention, chat-drafted 2026-08-22, not document-sourced. Written by Abad, approved by Abad 2026-08-22.

rules.statement: Weregild is drawn from the historical concept of a life's price paid in compensation for a killing. The organization's founding philosophy treats every discarded life, whether rejected from Maw candidacy, culled from an unlicensed breeding operation, or failed out of Branded-bloodline vetting, as a monetizable asset whose value is never allowed to go uncollected.
rules.source: Original invention, chat-drafted 2026-08-22, not document-sourced. Written by Abad, approved by Abad 2026-08-22.

rules.statement: The Weregildd's command layer, the Assessors, is a small, anonymous, compartmented council operating from Blakhanders' Cove's hidden underlevels. No single Assessor holds full operational visibility across all four circles. Culling quotas, labor allocation, and pit scheduling move through blind couriers using an Old-Dominion-derived cipher notation adapted from the same administrative tradecraft the Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures and the Meridian Register use.
rules.source: Original invention, chat-drafted 2026-08-22, not document-sourced. Written by Abad, approved by Abad 2026-08-22.

rules.statement: Weregildd enforcers, the Leash-Bound, are held compliant through a black-market derivative of Blight-Tether, the suppression mechanism developed against T.D.K.'s ex-Cestari forces. Unauthorized detachment from a handler's control collar triggers a Blight-relapse cascade within days. Weapons and pit-gates are keyed to density signature, self-locking against unregistered users.
rules.source: Original invention, chat-drafted 2026-08-22, not document-sourced. Written by Abad, approved by Abad 2026-08-22.

rules.statement: Weregildd stock comes from three sources: candidates culled from the roughly forty licensed Cestari breeding Farms (MAW-070) who fail selection, individuals rejected from the Slab Compact's Branded-fighter-bloodline vetting, and unlicensed black-market breeding operations the Weregildd runs directly at Blakhanders' Cove and satellite sites.
rules.source: Original invention, chat-drafted 2026-08-22, not document-sourced. Written by Abad, approved by Abad 2026-08-22.

rules.statement: Weregildd intake is sorted into the Freight Cut (labor, bred for bone density and recovery), the Pit Cut (arena stock, bred for reflex and aggression response), and the Hearth Cut (domestic and compliant labor, bred for low volatility). Those who fail all three classifications are simply Offcuts, the term the arena-betting circles borrowed for the organization's public alias, and are routed to the Salvage Concordance for bio-material reclamation.
rules.source: Original invention, chat-drafted 2026-08-22, not document-sourced. Written by Abad, approved by Abad 2026-08-22.

rules.statement: Weregildd movement doctrine, the Forty-Five-Day Turn, rotates captives on a forty-five-day cycle through sealed grain-holds, disused Maw-adjacent excavation tunnels, and coastal smuggling coves to prevent organized resistance or geographic mapping. Calendar and daylight markers are stripped from every holding site, and captives are identified only by an assigned alphanumeric mark.
rules.source: Original invention, chat-drafted 2026-08-22, not document-sourced. Written by Abad, approved by Abad 2026-08-22.

rules.statement: The Offcut Exchange, the Weregildd's arena circuit, runs three pit formats: the Asymmetric Pit (Offcuts against armed mercenaries at steep odds, wagered live), the Interspecies Gauntlet (Pit Cut fighters against Blight-conditioned predator packs in shifting arenas), and the Ironclaw Wilds (predators surgically fitted with Drakma-forged claw sheathing, held to aggression through the same Blight-derivative compulsion used on the Leash-Bound). Wagers move through closed Scrip-relay circuits and in-person galleries.
rules.source: Original invention, chat-drafted 2026-08-22, not document-sourced. Written by Abad, approved by Abad 2026-08-22.

rules.statement: The Writedown Compact, the Weregildd's economic circuit, extends predatory Scrip credit lines to struggling minor holds and mercenary houses, creating debt-bondage dependencies that discourage outside intervention. This sits parallel to, and could plausibly connect with, House Draeven and House Brekka's unresolved debt entanglement with the Legion (vector b of the corruption-vector plan); no direct link is asserted, pending further discussion.
rules.source: Original invention, chat-drafted 2026-08-22, not document-sourced. Written by Abad, approved by Abad 2026-08-22.

rules.statement: The Weregildd and the Slab Compact are not allied. The Compact protects its short list of Branded bloodlines from harm; the Weregildd exists specifically because of everyone the Compact's list excludes. A Compact handler who finds a Weregildd recruiter near a protected bloodline site treats it as a direct territorial violation, not an ordinary business dispute of the kind most cult-ecosystem organizations have with each other.
rules.source: Original invention, chat-drafted 2026-08-22, not document-sourced. Written by Abad, approved by Abad 2026-08-22.

rules.statement: Open connective-tissue flag, not asserted as canon: Red Beard's own backstory as a Farm-born Maw survivor puts him in the Weregildd's structural blast radius. A rejected Farm candidate or Compact-vetting failure in his generation would plausibly have been Weregildd stock. Whether he personally escaped this fate, or lost someone to it, is proposed as future invention-pass material only.
rules.source: Original invention, chat-drafted 2026-08-22, not document-sourced. Written by Abad, approved by Abad 2026-08-22.

rules.statement: The Concordat of the Long Account presents itself as a 240-year-old fraternal mutual-benefit society for merchants, factors, and financiers across the Astral Archipelago and Celestial Zenith trading networks (credit references, arbitration, a collective fund). The public layer is genuinely useful, and most members know nothing of the private layer beneath it. It was founded by Archipelago financiers who, through suppressed historical records, concluded the Scrip economy was not a neutral organic instrument but a deliberately designed system that suppresses wealth accumulation outside density-linked administrative designation while protecting families already wealthy at the Old Dominion's end.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: Twelve senior members, the Creditors, distributed across Archipelago and Zenith trading hubs, meet in person no more than once a year and otherwise communicate through the Concordat's own arbitration correspondence network, whose legitimate volume of commercial dispute traffic makes private communication invisible. The Creditors are investors, not believers: their thesis is that the current economic order is leveraged against a debt coming due at the Resumption, a financial event rather than a religious one, and an investor among them will sell if the price is right.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: Below the Creditors sit roughly two hundred Account-Holders, each managed by one Creditor and aware the private layer exists but not of the full network; below them sit several thousand Ledger-Clerks (couriers, warehouse managers, port factors, minor officials) purchased into cooperation through outsized versions of the same mutual-benefit mechanisms the public membership receives. The Weighing Communities' sixty-year courier arrangement (CULT-015, CULT-017) runs through this layer, feeding storage facilities distributed across port-city warehouses, no single one holding more than a fraction of the full portfolio.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Concordat's Accounting is a quarterly financial review using commercial notation indistinguishable from ordinary trading records to external auditors. The Sovereign Trust's own annual oversight of Concordat chapter accounts has never flagged an anomaly, because the notation system was purpose-built by the founding generation to be clean under exactly that review.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: Assembled over 240 years, the Concordat's relic portfolio is the largest private collection of authenticated Old Dominion material in existence: the calibration rod taken from the Domus Inviolate's murdered Reader (one piece of an incomplete three-piece Calibration Array), the Crown-Scar documentation rubbing confiscated from the Ledger Family head who tried to broker it (CULT-022), seven fragments of Warbody Residue across three storage facilities, documents acquired through 150 years of cooperation with the Measurist Guild's location service, and undeciphered Meridian Engine Shard fragments from the Dead Ledger Assembly's monitoring work. The Creditors know the portfolio is valuable; they lack the technical context to know what several of its most significant items actually are, including that the Warbody Residue is not an inert trophy but carries a genuinely dangerous biological effect on standard human physiology.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Concordat ordered the Domus Inviolate Reader's death to keep his public sale of Keeper-cabinet objects from setting a precedent that would open the same objects to the rest of the cult ecosystem. The ordering Creditor secured the calibration rod but left a Concordat commercial seal in the Reader's pocket, identifying an Account-Holder registered to a trading house that required SBD clearance to obtain. Fermand recognizes what that clearance requirement means immediately; this seal is the thread that pulls the investigation toward the SBD. Neither the ordering Creditor nor the identified Account-Holder knows the seal was found at the scene.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Creditor council has split six and six. The maintenance faction reads T.D.K.'s partial post-Great-Breach infrastructure activity (backlogged Oracle data processed, dead accounts receiving return deposits) as proof the thesis was right and only the timeline extended, and wants to hold the portfolio and network. The liquidation faction reads the crew's demonstrated capability as changing the risk calculation fundamentally and wants the portfolio liquidated and the network dissolved before the Reader's-body thread finds them; they have an undisclosed buyer the maintenance faction suspects wants the materials destroyed rather than preserved. Consensus has broken down; each faction now acts unilaterally wherever it holds operational authority.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Concordat knows of the Ledger Families' sealed Merak chamber (CULT-021) through its intelligence-sharing arrangement with the Measurist Guild, but doesn't know the families have found something in the chamber's approach area. The maintenance faction wants the contents for the portfolio; the liquidation faction wants the chamber sealed and suppressed. Neither can act without the other's agreement, and the fracture has suspended the decision while the Ledger Family council moves, slowly, toward opening it anyway.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: Nearly every relationship in the cult ecosystem, courier work, intelligence sales, authentication services, back-channels, permitting cover, routes through the Concordat's Account-Holder and Ledger-Clerk infrastructure, and no single Account-Holder has the full picture, only the Creditors do, each for their own geographic segment. The fracture is visibly degrading this function: delayed courier payments to the Weighing Communities, slower responses to the Measurist Guild, an unanswered two-month-old query from the Ledger Families. The Reader's-body thread is moving toward an organization that will be least able to manage the response coherently by the time it arrives.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures has no address, charter, membership roll, or governing body. It is the private-layer name a distributed network of administrative professionals (census bureaus, taxation offices, resource allocation departments, regulatory bodies across several nations) uses for itself. It was never founded in any organized sense; it emerged when professionals who separately recognized fragments of Old Dominion notation in their own official work found each other through the work itself, which means it can't be dismantled by arresting a founder or mapped by tracing a recruitment chain.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: Bureau members identify each other through a margin annotation formatted like a standard error correction but using a specific symbol combination. Recognizing it is the entire communication, since the flagged document's own content and path through official channels carries whatever context a member needs. Working groups of three to five members in adjacent administrative positions coordinate through this notation, by consensus, to produce outcomes such as a permitting decision routing a Concordat survey team to a needed site, a census adjustment protecting a settlement's autonomy, or a regulatory exemption aligned with Old Dominion commercial designation. No single act in the pattern is wrong on its own. The pattern is.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Bureau performs no collective observance. Its members believe that maintaining records in the format T.D.K.'s administration will require is itself the act of preparation, which makes their devotion indistinguishable from professional excellence and the Bureau functionally invisible from outside.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: Bureau members have spent decades making small, persistent, non-anomalous record alterations, undercounting some communities and overcounting others to shift resources toward settlements their internal analysis has designated Old-Dominion-significant, granting or denying regulatory exemptions by criteria aligned with Old Dominion commercial classification rather than any stated regulatory purpose. The Bureau does not experience this as falsification. In its own coherent vocabulary it is pre-positioning: correcting current-order records that are provisional in favor of the format the next order will require. The conviction is genuine, not a rationalization covering guilt.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: A Bureau member in the relevant Trust bureau filed both kings' death certificates within eleven minutes of the Fulfillment Ceremony ending, before any official confirmation had occurred, having received a working-group notation signal that a Resumption event was anticipated during the ceremony window and prepared the paperwork in advance. The member did not know the Three Ronin were carrying out a political assassination; they believed they were performing the Bureau's ordinary pre-positioning function. The eleven-minute filing window is the administrative anomaly Ezio finds.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: Fermand can read Bureau-style notation because he encountered an overlapping adaptation of the same Old Dominion cipher conventions in the SBD's oldest Black Iron Citadel research records. He does not initially recognize what he's reading as a functioning cult network; that connection is a conclusion he reaches, not information he starts with. Following the signal backward leads to a working group in the capital's trust bureau, and from there through three further document chains to a notation origin inside the SBD's own administrative infrastructure: someone who is a Bureau member and, separately, a member of a different organization entirely, whose cooperation served both organizations' interests. Finding this person produces two simultaneous revelations about two separate organizations.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Bureau has no central point of failure, so nothing stopped it after the containment. Decades of individually small adjustments are aggregating toward a point where official governance and Bureau-adjusted reality visibly diverge, producing resource-allocation failures the Bureau won't recognize as its own doing, since its framework treats the adjusted figures as accurate and any resulting failure as the current order's inadequacy being revealed rather than caused.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: A specific community in the Obsidian Prefecture's eastern borderland has had its recorded population understated by roughly fifteen percent for thirty years, introduced incrementally by two successive Bureau census-office members after internal analysis flagged it as an Old-Dominion-designated site requiring preserved autonomy. The undercount is invisible inside the census office, since the current Bureau member simply inherited the adjusted figure as the record. Its real consequence is thirty years of under-resourced roads, thin medical allocation, and inadequate harvest-shortfall coverage for a population the official record doesn't believe is that large.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Bureau is functionally indistinguishable from the institutions it lives inside without both notation literacy and multi-nation archive access spanning decades, and every archive it touches is protected by an institution whose reflex is to resist exactly that kind of external scrutiny. Fermand has the literacy but not yet the access; the investigation will reach a specific working group, not the Bureau as a whole, which stays unreachable by any single approach the current political environment permits.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Unmarked Fraction begins with an institutional grievance, not devotion. In the Fraction's reading of the SBD's own founding mandate, the organization was built to maintain T.D.K.'s clandestine governance infrastructure until his return and hand it back, not to accumulate institutional power for itself. Current SBD leadership's use of the King's monitoring architecture and intelligence networks to sustain its own post-Old-Dominion institutional power is, in the Fraction's vocabulary, embezzlement, and the Fraction is the internal audit function that embezzling leadership has no interest in permitting.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: A senior SBD archive-research analyst, roughly eighty years ago, concluded that two centuries of SBD operational decisions made sense as institutional-survival optimization but not as return-of-the-King optimization. Her report was classified and buried through ordinary procedure, inaccessible to her for the next twelve years. By the time she retrieved it, she had independently found other SBD personnel who'd reached adjacent conclusions through different evidence; she founded the Fraction by recognizing that convergence, not by recruiting.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Fraction organizes using the SBD's own covert communication infrastructure, since its members are SBD personnel with legitimate operational access, which means their traffic generates no anomalous access pattern. The risk is that SBD counterintelligence monitors that same infrastructure; the Fraction's security rests on leadership's assumption that this level of internal organization isn't possible without already having been detected. Roughly forty members sit concentrated in the SBD's middle hierarchy, with real operational access but no presence in the rooms where leadership decisions are made, part of why the embezzlement has been possible.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Fraction performs no collective ritual. Its members' commitment is expressed through ongoing professional work locating and placing beyond SBD leadership's operational reach the fragments of T.D.K.'s original governance infrastructure, pre-SBD Ten Tongues relay nodes and administrative systems predating the SBD's current institutional self-understanding. The goal is not to possess this infrastructure but to ensure the King has a functioning architecture to resume into rather than a landscape the SBD has spent five thousand years cannibalizing.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: A Fraction member documented, before dying, that the Fraction did not sanction the double regicide, that at least one current SBD leadership member had advance knowledge of it, and that the regicide served leadership's own institutional interests (eliminating a peace agreement that would have reduced the instability leadership uses to justify its expanded mandate, and killing both kings before a coalition could scrutinize SBD operations) rather than any T.D.K.-aligned interest. The analyst was killed by SBD leadership on an officially unrelated counterintelligence pretext, her genuine investigation reclassified as unauthorized access. Her removal generated the administrative record that is the thread Ezio will find before he finds the archive itself; he won't understand the connection until Fermand reads the notation.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The regicide showed the Fraction that SBD leadership will actively sabotage political developments threatening its institutional power, not merely passively misuse the King's assets. The Fraction's senior remaining operative has concluded, and shared with no one outside the Fraction, that leadership had Oracle-network intelligence about the Great Breach weeks in advance and deliberately did nothing, since a contained King is more useful to SBD leadership than a resumed one, who would re-assert root control and return the SBD to being his instrument rather than its own institution.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Fraction's unverified working theory, held only internally, is that SBD leadership may have taken deliberate steps to ensure T.D.K.'s activation occurred in a form maximizing leadership's own leverage over his return rather than his leverage over his own infrastructure, meaning certain SBD decisions before the Great Breach may have assisted the containment rather than merely failed to prevent it. The evidence sits in leadership-level records the Fraction can't currently access.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The senior operative has decided leadership's betrayal justifies action and is consolidating, rather than merely protecting, T.D.K.'s original command-architecture components at undisclosed locations, assembling inert relay hardware into a configuration that could be activated. Who would activate it is unresolved, the King is contained and unavailable, and her stated position is that betrayal creates the obligation to act as the betrayed party would have. The crew doesn't know the Fraction exists; the investigation is moving toward the dead analyst's body and archive, a first penetration layer, not toward the Fraction's current staging operations, a second and deeper layer of SBD covert infrastructure the investigation hasn't reached.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Fraction and the Obsidian Prefecture's Patient Caucus hold complementary resources and are on a path toward alliance neither has completed: the Caucus doesn't know the Fraction exists, and the Fraction distrusts legislative actors on the strength of the SBD's uniformly negative history with legislative oversight. The Concordat has the relationships to introduce them, but its internal fracture has suspended that function; whichever Concordat faction resolves the fracture first gets both the motivation and the mechanism to make the connection, one of the most consequential open questions in the post-containment landscape. The senior Fraction operative has known about the investigation since its first archive-access queries and has done nothing to obstruct it; the dead analyst's evidence sits exactly where she wants it, findable at the right time, a decision she's still completing.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Concordat of the Long Account' (contains The Concordat of the Long Account, The Bureau of Correct Weights and Measures, The Unmarked Fraction), Batch 13, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Pavilion of the True Weight began as a methodological coincidence: three Celestial Zenith researchers, across eleven years and separate divisions (density-variance patterns across post-Merak settlement geography, suppressed developmental pathways in Zenith educational protocols, a Trust-era medical directive with no scientific basis in the contemporaneous literature), independently reached the same conclusion. The Zenith's educational system contains deliberate inhibition, embedded during the early Sovereign Trust period, designed to prevent the population from developing the biological capacity T.D.K. represented, and it has worked for five thousand years.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The suppression runs through four independently justified, mutually unreferenced channels: physical training that avoids load-bearing skeletal-density work, nutritional standards that limit mineral-density inputs, neonatal protocols that classify high-density newborn development as a medical anomaly, and assessment frameworks that never measure density at all. A pre-Trust medical-records compendium documents a density distribution with an upper range the current Zenith population doesn't reach, a range normal across multiple pre-Trust cohorts that vanished from the institutional record within two generations of the Trust's consolidation.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Pavilion has grown to roughly thirty members over forty years by recognition, not recruitment. The three founders, now in their eighties, favor the strategy that built the evidentiary base (careful, distributed publication no single reader assembles into the full case), while younger members argue forty years of that strategy has produced only careful obscurity and want one comprehensive paper stating the case explicitly.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Pavilion holds the most biologically accurate understanding of T.D.K. in the entire cult ecosystem, and is theologically incompatible with every other organization in it. Where every other cult positions itself around his personal return and authority, the Pavilion believes he was a biological endpoint the population could have reached and was prevented from reaching, and wants the suppression reversed rather than the King restored. A world with his density profile and no royal authority is exactly the outcome that would make Old-Dominion-style governance unenforceable.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The comprehensive paper is roughly eight months from submission. It will be understood by perhaps forty people, all of whom will immediately recognize it as a demolition charge aimed at the Zenith's educational framework and, by extension, the Trust's governance premise. Its submission triggers a formal review, a raw-data demand, and a counter-expert panel, none of which can un-establish the underlying data even if they produce an alternative interpretation.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: A splinter sect called the Frequency Vigil operates inside the Pavilion's own institution and has misdirected the natural philosophy division's research for sixty years, slowing its approach to the Ten Tongues/Old Dominion construction connection by roughly two generations. The Pavilion doesn't know the Vigil exists; the misdirection reads as ordinary dead ends. The Frequency Vigil itself is still queued for its own expansion batch.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: Orlok knows the Pavilion exists and hasn't told Kanja everything about it. A current Pavilion researcher is his former student; he recognized where her work was heading years before anyone else and said nothing. He has known the suppression was real for longer than the founders have been alive, having watched it be installed, and does not discuss with anyone currently alive whether he could have prevented it.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: Orlok's silence is a timing calculation, not agreement with the Pavilion's approach. The comprehensive paper's roughly eight-month path to submission and the Zenith administration's roughly eight-month path to recognizing the publication pattern converge on the same window. He has watched both develop without intervening in either.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Pavilion is about to destabilize the Zenith's educational and governance framework at the same moment the Frequency Vigil's fifteen to twenty practitioners inside that same institution, actively undermining T.D.K.'s containment from the inside, become newly exposed to scrutiny. Both facts sit inside one institution and are about to surface in the same period; Orlok has known both for different lengths of time and has introduced neither to the crew.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Obsidian Prefecture Senate is already broadly hostile to the Trust and broadly sympathetic to T.D.K.'s return, so the Patient Caucus is defined by neither position. It's defined by timing. Publicly it argues standard moderate restraint; privately, the actual argument is that the conflict that matters is the one at the Resumption, and resources spent on a premature war with the Trust are resources unavailable for the Prefecture's position in that transition.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Caucus holds roughly a third of the Senate's voting membership, enough to block supermajority military commitments. A four-decade voting record consistently delays or defeats commitments of Prefecture force against Trust territory and any modification of the Prefecture's oldest Old-Dominion-derived legal statutes, always with legitimate strategic justification on the record, which is why the pattern reads as ordinary caution.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Caucus runs with full ordinary Senate-caucus machinery. Its private layer is thin, since forty years of internal coordination can't stay hidden from insiders in so transparent a legislature. What stays hidden from the broader Senate is the operational coordination itself, an intelligence and resource relay connecting to the Concordat of the Long Account through its commercial correspondence infrastructure.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: Decimus Korr, the Silence, operates out of Prefecture territory under Caucus-provided cover for roughly twelve years, in exchange for intermittent SBD clandestine intelligence the Concordat can't reliably supply. The Caucus did not know the Three Ronin were being used for the double regicide and did not sanction it.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: A Caucus senator on the Prefecture's security committee discovered the regicide investigation was moving toward the back-channel and told no one, calculating the Concordat would absorb the damage since the relay runs through its infrastructure. The calculation assumes the investigation stops at the relay's surface, a reasonable assumption about most investigations and not about one run by Ezio and Fermand.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Caucus has quietly designated three True-Map-flagged Old Dominion sites in Prefecture territory as protected heritage zones through ordinary legal channels: an Anchor Stone installation, an early administrative-facility ruin with preservation hardware in its sub-basement, and, most significantly, a mountain approach point that has blocked the Measurist Guild's survey access to one vector of the range believed to conceal T.D.K.'s administrative center for eight years, without the Guild connecting the designation to the Caucus's private motive.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Caucus intends to present the protected sites to T.D.K. as evidence of stewardship, negative evidence (prevented removal) rather than the Concordat's positive evidence (acquired objects), a bet derived from an interpretation of what the King will value, itself drawn from corrupted Ledger fragments obtained through the Concordat's network.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The containment splits the Caucus three ways. The smallest faction believes it's permanent and wants the private layer dissolved. The largest believes it's a victors' narrative and the existing strategy remains correct unchanged. The smallest but most consequential, two senators and four senior staff, has shifted toward active support for undoing the containment and made preliminary contact with the Unmarked Fraction (CULT-057) before the Concordat's fracture cut the relay.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: Ezio's investigation is moving toward the Three-Ronin/Caucus connection. The senator who said nothing is monitoring it through the Concordat relay, receiving the maintenance faction's self-interested optimism with no independent check. The investigation hasn't reached the relay yet; whether her calculation holds depends on whether the Concordat resolves its fracture first.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Dead Ledger Assembly began roughly two hundred years ago when Zenith Scrip-bank administrators uncovered a sealed Old Dominion banking records room during a demolition. The bank's self-taught archivist recognized the account numbers as designators for T.D.K.'s infrastructure functions rather than people, and found three still-valid, unclosed accounts in the current Trust Scrip registry, architecturally descended from the Old Dominion's own system.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: Seven founding administrators concluded the accounts were the Scrip-system identities of T.D.K.'s Predictive Oracle monitoring nodes, and that deposits into them would be logged and auditable on his return. They began with small, audit-safe quarterly deposits and formalized two practices: the Accounting (the deposit) and the Audit Practice (a closed quarterly review of that period's Scrip-market anomalies, interpreted as the Absent Creditor's activity, archived physically).
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Assembly's roughly three hundred members, in city-level chapters of ten to twenty-five, don't know each other; each chapter believes itself the sole legitimate Assembly. This isolation was never a deliberate security measure, it emerged because new chapters were founded person-to-person with no coordinating body, so no chapter has ever had a complete picture of the Assembly's scope.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: Each chapter's quarterly anomaly reports, interpreted internally as the Absent Creditor's activity, are in financial-analytic terms the real fingerprint of Trust financial interventions, SBD operational funding, and Concordat relic-acquisition expenditures. Two hundred years of these reports, distributed across roughly two hundred chapters, constitute a financial intelligence record no actual intelligence organization has produced.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The SBD wet-work team funding the Three Ronin's double regicide routed through a Zenith Scrip-bank clearinghouse that happens to house a Dead Ledger Assembly chapter. The chapter's three years of anomaly reports document the funding trail without the members knowing what they'd recorded; they read it as pre-Resumption activity.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: When Ezio reaches the clearinghouse archive, its chapter Keeper deploys every legitimate bureaucratic obstruction available before cooperating fully, not from defeat but from theological conviction: an investigation that penetrates his obstruction in an afternoon must be the Absent Creditor's own system operating through it. He's wrong about the mechanism and right that the investigation is genuinely uncovering T.D.K.'s infrastructure.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: At the Great Breach, T.D.K.'s revived monitoring system processes the Assembly's two centuries of backlogged deposits and returns an exact response, principal plus interest at the Old Dominion's original rate, compounded across the full two hundred years, correct to the decimal, to every chapter within the same forty-eight-hour window. No human institution could have produced that calculation. Each chapter experiences it as isolated confirmation, since none knows the others exist.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: Post-containment, Oracle nodes near Assembly chapters have begun emitting active bioelectric scanning pulses rather than just processing transactions. Chapter members nearby feel a new physical sensation the Assembly's two-hundred-year practice has no prior vocabulary for, and read it as the most direct confirmation yet.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: The Assembly's distributed archive is the single most significant unassembled intelligence resource in the post-containment Shattered Kingdoms. The investigation currently holds one chapter's worth; assembling the rest needs either reaching all two hundred directly or someone who already knows the full scope, neither of which exists yet. The clearinghouse Keeper personally holds an unresolved position: he helped contain the King's captors access records of the King's own return-funding, while receiving, in the same event, the most direct confirmation of his life that his practice was real. He keeps filing his Audit Practice, waiting for a framework the Accounting was never built to provide.
rules.source: Cult Dossier file 'Pavilion of the True Weight' (contains The Pavilion of the True Weight, The Patient Caucus, The Dead Ledger Assembly), Batch 14, approved by Abad 2026-08-22

rules.statement: A-1 resolved (Abad, 2026-08-23): Pyro's mother was both the last keeper of the Dhar-Kael tradition and an SBD-recruited veil-reader who discovered T.D.K.'s hidden architecture buried in the Directorate's oldest protocols; the Living Gate was T.D.K.'s containment response to that discovery, and she completed the Dhar-Kael bond before the curse took hold. Consistent with and does not alter MCD-131/132/133 (she survived the Living Gate event, fused into its architecture, rather than dying).
rules.source: Ambiguities A-1 through A-7 from the Canon Sync Audit (Codex vs Master Canon), resolved by Abad 2026-08-23 in a one-question-per-output walkthrough

rules.statement: A-2 resolved (Abad, 2026-08-23): Val Saeryn Kareth and Val Mirel Kareth are alive but in deep cover, a pragmatic move forced on them by necessity rather than a choice. Sephtis's own knowledge of their status remains genuinely uncertain even with this backstage truth locked, since deep cover means even those who knew them best would not know where they are now or whether they still live. In-world references to Sephtis 'remembering' them should read as uncertainty ('he does not know whether she still walks'), not as implying death.
rules.source: Ambiguities A-1 through A-7 from the Canon Sync Audit (Codex vs Master Canon), resolved by Abad 2026-08-23 in a one-question-per-output walkthrough

rules.statement: A-5 resolved (Abad, 2026-08-23): Drakmund Verehimu is the 'first Verehimu' referenced in WC-001/CC-018, the original Crown-Scar recipient, roughly 5,000 years old, contemporary with T.D.K.'s Deposition. Lineage: Drakmund -> Aethelgard Verehimu (his son) -> Ozmund Verehimu (his grandson); both later Crown-Scars are inherited from Drakmund, not independently installed.
rules.source: Ambiguities A-1 through A-7 from the Canon Sync Audit (Codex vs Master Canon), resolved by Abad 2026-08-23 in a one-question-per-output walkthrough

rules.statement: A-6 resolved (Abad, 2026-08-23): there are 16 Avatars total, with Pyro counted among them (consistent with the 16 Avatar Two-Tier Placements document and CC-047). The crew totals 17 once Kanja himself is counted alongside his 16 Avatars. This resolves the inconsistency flagged in CC-075: references to '17 Avatars' (including WC-014's Talisman synchronization-server framing) mean 17 crew members, not 17 Talisman-bonded recipients; the Talisman's Sovereign Umbrella protects the 16 Avatars as recipients, with Kanja as the source wearing it rather than a 17th recipient of his own device.
rules.source: Ambiguities A-1 through A-7 from the Canon Sync Audit (Codex vs Master Canon), resolved by Abad 2026-08-23 in a one-question-per-output walkthrough

rules.statement: A-4 resolved: Julian Dael-Koss's formal title is the Crew's Blood-Reader, not 'physician.' This distinguishes him from Nelle Adessi, the Kingdom's first physician (the civic role in Ozmund's Unchained Kingdom) -- a different person entirely.
rules.source: Ambiguities A-1 through A-7 from the Canon Sync Audit (Codex vs Master Canon), resolved by Abad 2026-08-23 in a one-question-per-output walkthrough

rules.statement: A-7 resolved: Duke Cassius Verehimu, 'the False Lion,' is Ozmund's corrupt cousin from a younger branch of House Verehimu and a named Sovereign Trust member, one of the four principals who ordered the assassination of Aethelgard Verehimu and Maro Rexmar at the Fulfillment Ceremony. Density 100x static (Elite Noble Standard, consistent with WC-024's exemplar); he does not fight with mass but with financial leverage.
rules.source: 'The House of Verehimu -- Inner Circle' (Canon-Integrated Supplement for World Codex v3.2 + Character Codex v1.0), uploaded by Abad 2026-08-23, resolves A-7

rules.statement: Cassius Verehimu is financially insolvent, leveraged by the Sealbound Directorate at a personal Scrip-debt exceeding his projected lifetime earnings by a factor of fifteen. He intends to seize the crown to liquidate House Verehimu's assets and pay debts the Directorate deliberately structured to be unpayable, not to rule. Aliases: the Steward / the Regent-in-Waiting (court), the Soft Target (Ezio's assessment -- the conspiracy's weakest link), the Tenant (Ozmund), Asset (SBD).
rules.source: 'The House of Verehimu -- Inner Circle' (Canon-Integrated Supplement for World Codex v3.2 + Character Codex v1.0), uploaded by Abad 2026-08-23, resolves A-7

rules.statement: As a Verehimu descended from Drakmund (MCD-138), Cassius carries the Crown-Scar. In Ozmund it manifests as command presence and controlled violence; in Cassius it manifests as will-to-dominate without the discipline to contain it -- the Crown-Scar's worst expression, raw ambition with hollow structure.
rules.source: 'The House of Verehimu -- Inner Circle' (Canon-Integrated Supplement for World Codex v3.2 + Character Codex v1.0), uploaded by Abad 2026-08-23, resolves A-7

rules.statement: Colonel Viktor Draconis is High Commander of the Verehimu House Guard, 700x static density (consistent with WC-024's exemplar), equipped in Heritage Drakma (Old-Era armor, heavier and less refined than Kanja's smithing but with immense static protection). He does not know Ozmund is a Gravity Titan and views Ozmund's entry into the Accession Games as a gladiator as madness or cowardice; his loyalty is genuine and his understanding incomplete, making him the most dangerously wrong man of the Interregnum.
rules.source: 'The House of Verehimu -- Inner Circle' (Canon-Integrated Supplement for World Codex v3.2 + Character Codex v1.0), uploaded by Abad 2026-08-23, resolves A-7

rules.statement: Draconis ordered the Sector 4 Purge, leveling a rebel district to protect the Verehimu estate, with civilian casualties justified as 'Structural Collateral.' He does not sleep well, never apologizes, and would do it again if the equation demanded it -- Old World Honor, the conviction that order justifies cost and that the cost is someone else's problem. Ezio's assessment: he cannot be bribed or threatened, only shown the ledger.
rules.source: 'The House of Verehimu -- Inner Circle' (Canon-Integrated Supplement for World Codex v3.2 + Character Codex v1.0), uploaded by Abad 2026-08-23, resolves A-7

rules.statement: Lucius Blackthorne is a Debt-Architect embedded within Verehimu nobility as an SBD double-agent, reporting to Grave-Analyst Abbott Gage and Executive Director A.M. Density 25x (baseline human); his power is entirely administrative. He orchestrated the Scrip-Insolvency Trap, restructuring House Verehimu's Scrip obligations so that Ozmund's ascension would trigger automatic liquidation of the estate, barring Ozmund from the throne without destroying the House.
rules.source: 'The House of Verehimu -- Inner Circle' (Canon-Integrated Supplement for World Codex v3.2 + Character Codex v1.0), uploaded by Abad 2026-08-23, resolves A-7

rules.statement: Lucius Blackthorne carries a Dead-Drakma-bound ledger tracking every noble family's Scrip-debt, a weapon of selective truth (unlike Onyx's Black Ledger, which is Drakma lattice-memory and cannot be falsified). He fears Onyx of Oblivion specifically: his soul is Hollowed at a 100% Scrip-debt ratio, and he believes Onyx's Whisper of Shadows would read him as Rust, brittle and weightless.
rules.source: 'The House of Verehimu -- Inner Circle' (Canon-Integrated Supplement for World Codex v3.2 + Character Codex v1.0), uploaded by Abad 2026-08-23, resolves A-7

rules.statement: Grulak, 'the Foundry-Beast,' is Cassius Verehimu's personal enforcer, a bio-synthetic experiment purchased from the Tia-Bog Foundries -- resolving the previously unexplained Codex reference to Cassius purchasing him. Density 900x static (synthetic boost, augmented not born); Chimera biology with bones reinforced by industrial scrap-metal and blood thickened with Abyssal Bile (lower quality than Vargo Vakas's). Classified by the SBD as Synthetic-Augment, not Avatar-class.
rules.source: 'The House of Verehimu -- Inner Circle' (Canon-Integrated Supplement for World Codex v3.2 + Character Codex v1.0), uploaded by Abad 2026-08-23, resolves A-7

rules.statement: Grulak functions as a narrative mirror to Ozmund: both massive, both dense, both fighting in the Accession Games arena, but Ozmund's power is sacred (Karesian blood, Crown-Scar inheritance, Density Spike mastery earned through 201 years of disciplined living) while Grulak's is purchased and synthetic. He carried out the Outer-Rim Massacre, walking through a labor strike at 900x density; the SBD covered it as a Mining Accident.
rules.source: 'The House of Verehimu -- Inner Circle' (Canon-Integrated Supplement for World Codex v3.2 + Character Codex v1.0), uploaded by Abad 2026-08-23, resolves A-7

rules.statement: The Still-Water Compact was founded roughly 150 years ago by a senior Astral Archipelago port authority administrator who was also, through her father's line, a Null-Walker descendant. She recognized that the Null-Walker oral tradition's harbor coordinates and tidal data matched, and were often more accurate than, her port authority's own Old Dominion-era depth records.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: Publicly the Compact is a maritime trade fraternity focused on dead-water channel navigation between the Astral Archipelago's outer islands and the Hollow Shogunate's coastal waters. Privately it maintains the Tidal Register, a continuously updated record of which ports and harbors the Compact believes T.D.K. holds lease-architecture over, functionally the Compact's version of the Measurist Guild's True Map.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: The Compact has roughly 150 members concentrated in port cities across the Astral Archipelago and the Hollow Shogunate's coastal network, with smaller presences in the Celestial Zenith and Obsidian Prefecture. Every member holds a position with operational access to harbor administration: port officials, maritime factors, customs administrators, harbor pilots, vessel registry clerks.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: At each port visit, a member performs a twenty-minute depth measurement indistinguishable from routine harbor inspection, comparing it against Old Dominion baseline records. Deviations are logged as "frequency shifts." A hundred and fifty years of this practice across every major Shattered Kingdoms port has produced the most complete longitudinal harbor depth dataset in the world, kept for devotional reasons but of immediate practical value to anyone who cares about maritime infrastructure.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: Members perform the Null-Sealing of Passages at recorded threshold sites: dropping a small lead marker inscribed with their registry number into the water, a three-second act indistinguishable from incidental debris. Tens of thousands of these markers now rest on the floors of major Shattered Kingdoms harbors, constituting, unknown to the Compact itself, the most complete membership documentation of any organization in the cult ecosystem.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: The Compact's port-authority members move Dead Drakma fragments and Old Dominion material, purchased from Null-Walker traders with no provenance required, through harbor channels without inspection records. This has made the Compact a transport layer for the Concordat of the Long Account's relic-storage network for roughly seventy years, a relationship that predates and structurally parallels the Concordat's sixty-year-old courier arrangement with the Weighing Communities (CULT-015).
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: The Null-Walker communities sell material to the Compact without understanding what becomes of it afterward; neither side has asked the other. The Compact pays in Scrip at rates the Null-Walkers find acceptable specifically because payment is consistent and undocumented.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: The Concordat's post-containment internal fracture has frozen the supply chain: the Concordat's storage network isn't accepting new deliveries while its maintenance and liquidation factions dispute the portfolio's future. The Compact currently holds three staged shipments with no delivery instructions, and Null-Walker suppliers are unpaid for material delivered three months ago. If payment doesn't arrive within a month, the arrangement suspends.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: After the Great Breach, Oracle nodes embedded at coastal threshold sites (Old Dominion Ten Tongues relay architecture) partially activated, producing depth-measurement anomalies the Compact reads as confirmation of the Resumption. In fact the Tidal Register has become the most complete real-time monitoring record of T.D.K.'s coastal Oracle infrastructure that exists anywhere, data nobody with the interpretive framework to use it knows is there. The crew's investigation has not reached the Compact.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: The Meridian Register is the most formally organized of the three urban cult societies: roughly 400 members across all five Shattered Kingdoms nations, in city-level chapters of ten to twenty, under a Keeper-General, regional Keepers per nation, and chapter Keepers per city. The hierarchy tracks depth of professional access to Old Dominion-formatted source material, not seniority.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: Members believe T.D.K.'s return will discard every current government's records entirely and require documentation in Old Dominion administrative format. Each member maintains a secret Duplicate Registry alongside their legitimate day-job records. Induction requires six to twelve months learning the Old Dominion cipher, which most initiates believe is a devotional ritual language; it is in fact the Old Dominion's working Central Ledger administrative cipher.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: Two hundred years of Duplicate Registry production across four hundred members in five nations has, through an unintended cross-referencing effect, reconstructed roughly forty percent of a functional historical record of Old Dominion administrative holdings, including asset inventories for preservation sites no current government has records of. No single chapter holds enough to be dangerous; assembled, the forty percent is.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: The current Keeper-General is an Obsidian Prefecture land title administrator of twenty-two years, whose archive contains more original Old Dominion notation than any other member's access reaches. She discovered the cross-reference phenomenon roughly fifteen years ago, spent three years verifying it, and has shared it only with the regional Keepers, in cipher-compressed form, out of concern for how four hundred members would react to the discovery all at once.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: The Keeper-General holds a Meridian Engine Shard, a physical fragment of T.D.K.'s Broken Meridian scenario-modeling infrastructure, recovered twenty-two years ago from a sealed sub-basement records room during a land title transfer. She can read roughly sixty percent of what it encodes: a T.D.K.-authored Old Dominion planning document for the Resumption's administrative transition, which lists the Register's own cipher format as a stated prerequisite. She doesn't know whether the Register's work was shaped by the Shard's existence or independently converged on the same format.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: Several chapter archives contain Duplicate Registry fragments the Keeper-General has tentatively, and so far privately, identified as possible Crown-Scar installation schematics: not a complete procedure, but potentially enough of a starting point for a capable engineer if the fragments were ever assembled. She has disclosed this identification to no one pending further verification.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: Post-containment, the reconstructed forty percent's undiscovered preservation-site inventories raise an open question the Keeper-General is sitting with rather than acting on: whether the original containment effort accounted for every component of T.D.K.'s infrastructure, or left some of it unlocated in sites nobody currently knows to look for.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: The Ash-Remnant Clans are forty to sixty discrete extended family lines occupying the high-plateau fractured territories between Aethel-Gard and the Obsidian Prefecture. They farm nothing, trade with no outsiders, and defend territory they believe is inviolably registered in T.D.K.'s Central Ledger. They have no shared leadership or administrative structure, only periodic gatherings at Null-Ground sites, which is precisely why five thousand years of habitation has never produced a leadership to capture or a headquarters to locate.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: Every newborn is tattooed on the left forearm with a genealogical registry entry in Old Dominion administrative script, intended to keep the family permanently in T.D.K.'s Central Ledger. Five thousand years of parent-to-child copying has corrupted most lines to between forty and eighty percent inaccuracy. Exactly three families still carry accurate entries, each through an unrelated historical accident of contact with a genuine source document; none of the three know they're the exceptions.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: Three times a year, tied to tidal-cycle pressure thresholds, Clan families perform the Null-Sealing: a twenty-four-hour household lockdown sealed with a genuinely frequency-dampening Old Dominion mineral compound. The families believe this makes their household more visible to T.D.K.'s monitoring; the actual, opposite effect is that Old Dominion privacy architecture makes the household less visible to any other surveillance. They are using a privacy technology as a devotional practice.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: The Clans' oral tradition preserves one materially accurate fact, framed with inverted moral valence: that the Rexmar bloodline is the signal the Absent Creditor moves toward, the disruption pattern that preceded the Old Dominion's fall. This is factually correct, since the Crown-Scar architecture was calibrated to detect and respond to the Rexmar bloodline as T.D.K.'s own return trigger, but the Clans frame Rexmar as the antagonist disrupting T.D.K. rather than the reverse.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: A minority of families possess Null-Rods, portable Old Dominion anti-resonance field generators originally built as privacy devices for Ten-Tongues-proof administrative meetings, which the Clans revere as ceremonial objects without understanding their function. Mishandling one in an enclosed space causes lethal pressure collapse; the Clans have killed more of their own members this way across five millennia than through any external threat, and have developed an empirically correct but not understood partial safety protocol from generations of observing what precedes a death and what doesn't.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: After the Great Breach, the three registry-accurate families, gathering at Null-Ground sites with newly active Oracle fragments, triggered an authenticated bioelectric feedback pulse the Oracle logs as a valid Tier-2 administrative access credential, never formally deactivated across five thousand years of dormancy. The families read this as the Absent Creditor's personal recognition; in truth, T.D.K.'s monitoring architecture has now logged their names and registry numbers as currently active credentials.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: The Ash-Remnant Clans sit entirely outside the crew's current investigation. The only thread that could lead to them runs through Null-Walker circuit-route contact points, and Null-Walker circuit information is that community's most fiercely protected secret.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1ris9Qv1EXIS4NSsHGO8WH-klmnR5lxOH ('Still-Water Compact' file, containing The Still-Water Compact, The Meridian Register, and The Ash-Remnant Clans), Batch 15, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it'

rules.statement: The Null-Walkers are the oldest continuously operating cult in the Shattered Kingdoms, a peripatetic community of twenty to two hundred people with no fixed settlement, traveling Old Dominion ruin sites across all five nations on predetermined annual routes. They began as workers maintaining active Old Dominion infrastructure and became pilgrims, a transition the community no longer remembers happening.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1UOIhe0nOvxzVlnmYr99Pj8oC0Om0bSt_ (The Null-Walkers, The Zero-Point Households, plus the Cross-Ecosystem Summary appendix), Batch 16, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it in.'

rules.statement: The circuit is encoded in roughly eleven-thousand-year-old oral verse: navigational landmarks, tidal and geological markers, and ruin coordinates, plus structural descriptions of ruin interiors, approach vectors for major Old Dominion installations, depth assessments, and site-access timing tied to tidal and atmospheric conditions. This information exists nowhere else. It is transmitted by rote memorization from childhood and verified against other members' verses, with discrepancies corrected toward the oldest known version.
rules.source: Google Drive dossier file, fileId 1UOIhe0nOvxzVlnmYr99Pj8oC0Om0bSt_ (The Null-Walkers, The Zero-Point Households, plus the Cross-Ecosystem Summary appendix), Batch 16, approved by Abad 2026-08-23: 'lock it in.'

rules.statement: Circuit information is the community's most protected possession, protected more fiercely than their own lives.
